tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas bdun pa'i tshig 'grel bzhugs/

gnyis pa mkhas par bya ba'i yon tan gtan la dbab pa la/ shes pa'i yon tan gtan la dbab pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi yon tan gtan la dbab pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang ldan tshul dang thob tshul dang khyad par gyi chos dang bzhi/ dang po la/ bzod shes dang lta ba'i khyad par/ shes pa bcu'i rnam gzhag /de dag gi khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dri med bzod rnams shes pa min/ /zad dang mi skye'i blo lta min/ /de las gzhan 'phags blo gnyis ka /gzhan shes drug ni lta ba'ang yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir bzod pa dang shes pa dang yang dag pa'i lta ba zhes bshad na de rnams kyi khyad par ji ltar zhe na/ dri med zag med bzod pa brgyad kyi shes rab rnams chos can/ bzod shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes pa ma yin te/ rang yul la mi skrag pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes kyang the tshom spangs pa'i nges pa'i ngo bor ma skyes pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya the tshom spong byed yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ lta ba yin te/ nye bar rtog cing 'tsho ba'i shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ zad dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo chos can/ lta ba min te/ nye bar rtog pa med cing yongs su tshol ba'i rang bzhin can ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ so sor rtog pa tsam yod kyang bya ba byas zin pas yongs su tshol ba mi byed pa'i phyir/ snga ma de dag las gzhan 'phags pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes sogs brgyad kyi blo shes rab chos can/ bzod shes kyi shes pa dang lta ba gnyis ka yin te/ rang yul la the tshom spangs pa'i nges pa dang nye bar rtog pa'i ngo bo yang yin pa'i phyir/ zag med las gzhan 'jig rten pa'i rnam shes tshogs drug dang nyon mongs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi shes rab rnams chos can/ lta ba min te/ lta shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan dmigs bsal 'jig lta sogs lta ba lnga dang 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang drug ni chos can/

kun rdzob shes par ma zad/ lta shes gnyis kyi lta ba'ang yin te/ yul la rtog cing tshol ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes pa zag bcas zag pa med/ ces byung*/ skabs 'dir bshad pa'i shes pa chos can/ khyod la bcu yod de/ kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ chos shes pa dang*/ rjes su shes pa dang sdug bsngal shes pa dang kun 'byung shes pa dang 'gog pa shes pa dang lam shes pa dang sems shes pa dang zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ bcu po de thams cad chos can/ bsdu na gnyis su 'du ste/ zag bcas dang zag pa med pa'i shes pa gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dang po kun rdzob ces bya'o/ /zag med rnam gnyis chos can ni/ /rjes su shes pa kho na yin/ /kun rdzob yul ni thams cad do/ /chos zhes bya ba'i spyod yul ni/ /'dod sdug bsngal sogs rjes shes pa'i/ /spyod yul gong ma'i sdug bsngal sogs/ /zhes byung*/ shes pa gnyis po de chos can/ khyod las shes bcu'i shes pa gsum du 'jog tshul yod de/ shes pa dang po zag bcas kun rdzob shes pa zhes bya la/ zag med la chos shes pa dang rjes su shes pa rnam pa gnyis kho na yod pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po kun rdzob shes pa chos can/ dmigs yul la ni chos thams cad yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan thams cad de yin pa'i phyir/ chos shes pa zhes bya ba'i blo chos can/ khyod kyi spyod yul te dmigs pa ni yod de/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal dang sogs kyi sgras kun 'byung 'gog lam dag la dmigs pa'i phyir/ rjes su shes pa chos can/ khyod kyi dmigs pa yod de/ khyod kyi spyod yul ni 'dod pa'i gong ma'i sdug bsngal sogs kyi bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang*/ zad dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis/

dang po la/ chos shes kyi dbye ba dang*/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gnyis las brgyad du dbye ba dang*/ bzhi las bcu gnyis su dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag nyid ldan bye brag gis/ /bzhi ste zhes byung*/ chos shes dang rjes shes de dag nyid chos can/ khyod la brgyad du dbyer yod de/ bden bzhi'i bye brag gis rim bzhin du 'og ma dang gong ma'i bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi dang rjes shes bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam bzhi de dag ni/ mi skye ba dang zad pa shes/ /de gnyis dang po skyes pa ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu rjes shes pa yin/ zhes byung*/ chos dang rjes shes rnam pa bzhi po de dag chos can/ khyod la ni shes pa bcu gnyis re yod de/ chos shes bzhi dang chos shes bzhi gang rung dang*/ /de dag gi skye ba shes pa bzhi dang mi skye ba shes pa bzhi dang brgyad de bcu gnyis re yod pa'i phyir/ mi skye ba dang zad pa shes pa de gnyis chos can/ khyod dang por skyes pa ni sdug kun rjes shes yin te/ sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa la dmigs pa'i rjes su shes pa zhes bshad pa de yin pa'i phyir te/ srid rtse'i sgom spang dgu pa dang sdug kun la dmigs nas/ rdo rjai lta bu'i rjes su dang por zad pa shes shing*/ de nas mi skye ba shes nas slar shes par byar med pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhi las pha rol sems rig pa/ des ni sa dbang gang zag 'das/ /zhig dang ma skyes mi rig go /chos rjes blo phyogs phan tshun min/ /nyan thos mthong ba'i skad cig gnyis/ /rig ste bse ru lta bus gsum/ /sangs rgyas sbyor ba med par kun/ /zhes byung*/ pha rol gyi sems rig pa de chos can/ bzhi las byung ste/ chos shes rjes shes lam shes kun rdzob shes pa bzhi las byung zhing de'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ sems shes de chos can/ yul nges pa can yin gyi kun rig pa min te/

chos kyis sa 'das pa gong ma'i sems mi rig /dbang po rtul ba dad mos lta bus rno ba mthong thob lta bu'i sems mi rig/ /gang zag slob pas dgra bcom pa'i sems mi rig pa'i phyir te/ de dag de'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ da ltar ba'i yul can kho na yin te/ yul da ltar ba rig gi pha rol gyi sems 'das nas zhig pa dang ma skyes pa'i ma 'ongs pa mi rig pa'i phyir/ khyod phan tshun so sor nges pa yin te/ chos shes dang rjes shes kyi blo'i phyogs la dmigs pas phan tshun shes pa min pa'i phyir te/ shes pa de gnyis khams 'og ma dang gong ma'i gnyen po la so sor dmigs pa'i phyir/ mthong lam la pha rol gyi sems shes med kyang mthong lam de chos can/ khyod la dmigs pa'i sems shes gsum yod de/ nyan thos kyi sems shes des mthong ba'i lam gyi chos bzod dang chos shes skad cig ma dang po gnyis rig la/ gzhan mi rig /bse ru lta bu'i sems shes kyis dang po gnyis dang brgyad pa kun 'byung rjes shes dang gsum rig cing gzhan mi ri/ /sangs rgyas kyi sems shes kyis 'bad rtsol gyi sbyor ba med par kun gzigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ zad pa shes pa bden rnams la/ /yongs shes la sogs nges pa'o/ /yongs shes byar med ces la sogs/ /mi skye ba yi blor 'dod do/ /ces byung*/ zad dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo chos can/ khyod gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ zad pa shes pa ni bden pa rnams las sdug bsngal yongs su shes so/ /dmigs kyis kun 'byung spangs so/ /'gog pa mngon du byas so/ /lam sgom mo zhes nges pa yin la/ sdug bsngal yongs su shes te slar yongs su shes par byar med ces pa dang*/ la sogs kyis kun 'byung spangs so slar spang bar byar med/ 'gogs pa mngon du byas te slar mngon du byar med/ lam bsgoms te slar bsgom par byar med ces shes pa'i ye shes dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blor 'dor pa'i phyir/

'di ltar shes pa ni mnyam gzhag gi skabs su min te/ mnyam gzhag des drangs pa'i nges shes de 'dra rjes thob tu skye ba la dgongs pa'i phyir zhes bye smra 'dod do/ /gsum pa khyad chos la/ shes pa bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po'i khyad par/ rnam pa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin dang ni gnyen po dang*/ /rnam pa rnam pa spyod yul dang*/ /sbyor dang bya ba byas nyid dang*/ /rgyu rgyas pa las bcu yin no/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir bstan pa'i shes pa de chos can/ bsdus na gsum yin kyang bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang bzhin las kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ gnyen po las chos shes dang rjes shes/ rnam pa las sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung shes pa dang*/ rnam pa dang spyod yul de dmigs pa gnyis ka las 'gog pa dang lam shes pa dang*/ sbyor ba las pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang*/ bya ba byas pa nyid las zad pa shes pa dang*/ rgyu rgyas pa las ni mi skye ba shes pa zhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dang po des rang bzhin kun rdzob tsam shes/ gnyis pa de gnyis ni 'dod pa dang khams gong ma'i gnyen po yin/ gsum pa de gnyis dmigs pa sdug bden la dmigs kyang rnam pa tha dad/ bzhi pa gnyis dmigs rnam gnyis ka tha dad/ lnga pa ni sems so so la sbyor ba so sor dgos/ drug pa ni bya ba byas pa'i rgyud la dang po kho nar skye/ bdun pa ni rang gi rgyu rgyas pa las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam la 'gog pa'am/ /lam la chos shes gang yin de/ khams gsum gyi ni gnyen po yin/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi rjes ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ mthong lam chos shes 'dod pa dang rjes shes gong ma'i gnyen po yin kyang*/ sgom lam chos can/ khyod la der ma nges te/ khyod la 'gog pa'am/ lam la chos shes pa gang yin pa de ni khams gsum gyi gnyen po yin pa srid pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi 'phags pas 'dod pa'i sgom spang rnams chos shes kyis rim par spangs nas gong ma'i sgom spang rnams sngar 'dris pa'i lam de nyid bskyed nas spong srid pa'i phyir/

'dod pa'i khams gyi gnyen po rjes shes kyis byed pa ma yin te/ chos shes kyis spang 'dod par gnyen po byas zin pa'i phyir/gsum pa shes bcu'i rnam pa'i khyad par la/ shes pa so so'i rnam pa dang*/ rnam pa'i grangs nges/ de dag gi khyad par/ chos gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes/ /rnam pa bcu drug kun rdzob ni/ /de bzhin gzhan du'ang rang rang gi /bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /pha rol yid shes dri med kyang*/ /de bzhin dri ma dang bcas ni/ /shes bya'i rang gi mtshan nyid do/ /rdzas re re zhig spyod yul lo/ /lhag ma rnam pa bcu bzhi can/ /stong dang bdag med ma gtogs so/ /zhes byung*/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes pa chos can/ rnam pa bcu drug can yin te/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa chos can/ rnam pa du ma can yin te/ sbyor lam drod rtse'i skabs su snga ma de bzhin du bden pa'i rnam pa bcu drug can dang*/ de las gzhan du'ang chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog lam shes pa bzhi chos can/ rnam pa bzhi pa can yin te/ rang gi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/ pha rol yid shes la zag pa dang bcas bral gnyis yod pa las yid shes dri med de zag med kyang chos can/ bden bzhi shes pa de bzhin du bden bzhi'i rnam pa can yin te/ de bzhi'i spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/ pha rol gyi yid shes dri ma dang bcas pa ni chos can/ rang gi shes bya'i rang gi mtshan nyid de rang mtshan spyod yul can yin te/ pha rol gyi sems dang sems byung gi rdzas ni re re zhig kho na'i spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang gi tshe 'di sems so snyam du 'dzin pa'i tshe sems byung ngo snyam du mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa'i lhag ma zad dang mi skye ba'i shes pa gnyis chos can/

rnam pa bcu bzhi can yin te/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa las stong dang bdag med ma gtogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan bcu bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dri med bcu drug gzhan nam med/ /gzhan yod ces pa bstan bcos las/ /rdzas su rnam pa bcu drug go /zhes byung*/ 'dir lugs gnyis las kha che ba rnams na re/ bden pa'i rnam pa dri med bcu drug tu ma gtogs pa gzhan med ces zer la/ de la nyi 'og pa na re bcu drug las gzhan yod ces smra ste/ bstan bcos las rigs pas bskyed pa'i sgo nas mi rtag pa dang zhes pa nas rkyen te 'di ni gnas yod do/ /'di ni gzhi yod do/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gnas yod do zhes pas mtshan nyid yod pa dang*/ gzhi yod do zhes pas rgyu yod par bstan pa'i phyir zer/ rnam pa bcu drug po 'di ci ming gi sgo nas sam rdzas su bcu drug yin zhe na/ 'di la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba yod kyang*/ bye brag tu smra ba na re/ rdzas su yang rnam pa bcu drug yin te/ rnal 'byor pa dang rnam pa so sor mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ bcu drug tu bzhag pa ni ming gi rnam grangs kyi yin mod/ de tsam zhig min te/ bden bzhir don mi 'dra ba'i ldog pa bzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rkyen gyis 'jig pa'i mi rtag pa dang*/ bde ba'i rang bzhin min pa dang*/ skye 'jig can yin pa dang*/ bdag gis stong pa sogs don mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ rnam pa shes rab dang bcas pa'i/ /dmigs dang bcas pas 'dzin par byed/ /yod pa thams cad gzung bya yin/ /zhes byung*/ skabs 'di'i shes pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ bye smra na re/ shes pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yod de/ yul 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ shes rab kho nas 'dzin pa ni min te/ shes rab dang bcas pa'i sems sems byung dmigs pa dang bcas pa kun gyis 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir/

rdzas btags kyi yod pa thams cad chos can/ gzung bya yin te/ shes rab dang bcas pa'i sems sems byung rnams kyi gzung bya yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa la/ ngo bo dang rten dang dran pa nyer gzhag dang dmigs pa'i khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rnam pa rnam gsum gzhan rnam dbye/ zhes byung*/ bden pa'i rnam pa bcu chos can/ khyod la dge sogs gang 'jog pa'i khyad par yod de/ dang po kun rdzob shes pa la dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum yod cing*/ shes pa gzhan rnam pa dgu ni dger/ kho nar 'jog pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ khams gsum gyi shes pa zag bcas thams cad kun rdzob shes par 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste sems shes ni bsgoms byung dang shes pa gzhan rnams zag med la 'jog pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ sems rten dang*/ lus rten gnyis/ dang po ni/ dang po sa rnams thams cad na/ /drug na chos shes bya dgu na/ rjes shes bya ba de bzhin drug /gzhan yid shes pa bsam gtan na/ /zhes byung dang po kun rdzob shes pa chos can/ sa rnams thams cad na yod de/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ chos shes zhes bya ba chos can/ sa drug na yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi mi lcogs med dang bsam gtan khyad par can na yod pa'i phyir/ rjes shes zhes bya ba chos can/ sa dgu na yod de/ bsam gtan sa drug po de dang gzugs med dang po gsum ste dgu na yod pa'i phyir/ sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi dang zad dang mi skye shes pa drug chos can/ sngar bshad pa de bzhin du yod de/ sa drug dang dgu na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos shes rnams sa drug dang rjes shes rnams sa dgu na yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan ming shes pa de chos can/ bsam gtan bzhi kho na na yod de/ 'on kyang nyer bsdogs dang gzugs med na med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de ni 'dod dang gzugs rten can/ /chos zhes bya ba 'dod rten can/ khams gsum pa'i rten can gzhan/

/zhes byung*/ gzhan sems shes pa de ni chos can/ 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi rten can la yin te/ de gnyis su mngon du byed kyi gzugs med kyi rten la mi byed pa'i phyir/ chos zhes bya ba ni chos can/ 'dod pa'i rten can kho na la skye'i khams gong na mngon du mi byed de/ de na mthong lam mi skye ba'i phyir/ de gnyis las gzhan bden bzhi shes pa dang rjes shes dang zad mi skye shes pa brgyad chos can/ khams gcig tu ma nges te/ khams gsum pa yi rten can la skye ba yod pa'i phy-ir/gsum pa ni/ 'gog blo dran pa nyer gzhag pa/ gcig ste pha rol sems blo ni/ /gsum mo lhag ma bzhi yin no/ /zhes byung*/ 'gog pa shes pa'i blo chos can/ dran pa nyer gzhag gcig dang ldan te/ chos dran pa nyer gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ pha rol gyi sems blo shes pa chos can/ dran nye gsum dang ldan te/ lus dran nye ma gtogs gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ lhag ma'i shes pa brgyad chos can/ dran nye bzhi dang ldan pa yod de/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi ga la dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dmigs pa'i khyad par la/ shes pa nang phan tshun yul du 'gyur tshul/ chos bcu dang shes bcu yul yul can du sbyar ba/ chos gang rig pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos blo'i spyod yul dgu yin no/ /sdug bsngal rgyu blo'i gnyis yin no/ /bzhi yi bcu yin gcig gi min/ /zhes byung*/ chos shes pa'i blo chos can/ khyod kyi spyod yul la ma dmigs pa yod de/ rjes shes ma gtogs pa'i dgu yod pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam shes pa dang rjes shes kyi blo chos can/ khyod gnyis kyi dmigs pa la dgu dgu yod de/ snga ma la kun rdzob shis pa ma gtogs pa dang*/ phyi ma la chos shes ma gtogs pa rnams yod pa yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung shes pa'i blo chos can/ khyod gnyis kyi dmigs pa gnyis yin te/ kun rdzob shes pa dang pha rol gyi sems shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

kun rdzob dang sems shes dang zad dang mi skye shes pa bzhi chos can khyod kyi dmigs pa bcu yin te/ shes pa bcu po la dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin yang nang gses kyi khyad par yod de/ thams cad la cig car dmigs pa'i nges pa can min zhing*/ bden bzhi so so'i rnam pa la dmigs tshul mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa shes pa chos can/ khyod gcig pu'i dmigs pa la shes pa yod pa min te/ 'dus ma byas kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir te/ 'gog pa nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chos bcu dag ni sbyar bar bya/ khams gsum pa dang dri med chos/ /ma byas rnam gnyis rnam gnyis so/ /zhes byung*/ shes bcu chos can/ khyod chos bcu dag dang yul yul can du sbyaur tshul yod de/ kun rdzob shes pa'i dmigs pa la chos bcu po thams cad yod/ chos shes kyi de la lnga/ rjes shes kyi der bdun/ sdug kun shes pa'i der drug /'gog pa shes pa'i der gcig /lam shes pa'i der gnyis/ gzhan rnams kyi der gsum/ zad dang mi skye shes pa'i dmigs par dgu yod pa'i tshul gyis sbyar bar bya ba'i phyir/ chos bcu 'jog tshul yod de/ sngar ltar bcu ni khams gsum pa'i chos dang*/ dri med kyi chos bzhi la mtshungs ldan yin min rnam gnyis su phye bas brgyad dang*/ 'dus ma byas la dge bar btags pa dang lung ma bstan rnam gnyis su phye bas bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ kun rdzob gcig pus rang tshogs las/ /gzhan ni bdag med nyid rig 'gyur/ zhes byung*/ kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu chos can/ chos bcu la dmigs pa yod kyang rang gi ngo bo dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i tshor 'du sogs ha cang nye bas mi 'dzin te/ 'dzin pa'i byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir te/ rang gis rang la byed pa 'jug pa mi rigs pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan pa'i chos ni des rig par 'gyur ba yod de/ chos thams cad ni bdag med pa nyid do zhes shes par 'gyur ba'ang yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ldan tshul ni/ zag med skad cig dang po la/ chags can zhes pa gcig dang ldan/ gnyis pa la gsum yan chad ni/ /bzhi la re re 'phel dang ldan/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gang zag gang shes pa gang dang ldan tshul yod de/ zag med skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i 'phags pa chags can sdug bsngal chos bzod pa ni/ kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu dang ldan/ gnyis pa sdug bsngal rjes bzod la gnas pa ni kun rdzob dang chos dang sdug bsngal shes pa gsum dang ldan/ de yan chad ni snga ma gsum dang sems shes bzhi dang ldan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal rjes shes dus su chags can rjes shes dang bzhi/ chags bral lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du re re 'phel ba kun 'byung shes par chags bcas lnga dang chags bral drug /'gog pa shes par chags can drug chags bral bdun/ lam shes par chags bcas bdun chags bral brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa dang ldan pa mang ste/ 'dod pa la chags bral ma byas pa'i so skye thams cad ni de dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa thob tshul la/ lam gyi gnas skabs gang du shes pa du thob pa dang*/ sa gang du shes pa du thob pa dang*/ thob pa'i dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ mthong lam du dang*/ sgom lam du dang*/ bshad pa'i lhag ma du thob pa gsum/ dang po ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*/ /shes pa ji ltar skyes pa rnams ma 'ongs pa thob de nyid la/ /rjes gsum la ni kun rdzob kyang*/ /de phyir mngon rtogs mtha' zhes bya/ /de ni mi skye'i chos can yin/ /rang dang 'og sa 'gog pa'i mtha'/ /rang bden rnam can 'bad las byung*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ skabs gang du lan gong 'og pa'i khyad par yod de/ mthong ba'i lam la ni bzod pa brgyad dang shes pa ji ltar skyes pa rnams rang gi rigs 'dra ma 'ongs pa thob par 'gyur gyi/ mngon du gyur pa ni 'thob par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ thob zin slar mi thob pa'i phyir ro/ / mthong lam de ni chos can/

khyod la sdug kun 'gog pa rjes shes gsum la ni kun rdzob shes pa yang thob par 'gyur te/ de rjes shes kyi skabs su thob kyi chos shes kyi tshe mi thob pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa de chos can/ mngon rtogs kyi mtha' las byung ba zhes bya ste/ bden pa de mngon par rtogs pa'i rjes shes kyi tshe byung ba de'i phyir/ rjes shes gsum gyi kun rdzob shes pa de ni chos can/ mngon gyur du mi 'byung ste/ ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyi kun rdzob shes pa chos can/ sa gang la brten nas thob pa yod de/ mthong lam gang la brten pa'i rang sa dang 'og sa la brten nas thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa de gsum chos can/ dran pa nyer gzhag gang du 'jog tshul yod de/ 'gog pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa ni chos dran nye dang*/ lhag ma gnyis la dran nye bzhi ga bzhag tu yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum chos can/ dmigs rnam yod de/ rang gi bden pa'i dmigs rnam can yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'bad rtsol las byung ba yin te/ rang rang gi bden pa mngon rtogs rjes shes las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgom lam du thob pa ni/ chags bcas bcu drug pa la drug /'dod chags dang ni bral bas bdun/ /de yi gong ma chags bcas kyis/ /sgom pa'i lam la bdun 'thob bo/ /sa bdun las rgyal mngon shes dang*/ /mi g.yo 'thob dag spel brtson pa'i/ /bar chad med pa'i lam dag dang*/ /gong ma'i grol ba'i lam brgyad la'ang*/ /slob pa sbyong ba'i grol ba la/ /shes pa drug dang bdun 'thob pa'am/ /bar chad med pa'i lam la drug /de bzhin srid rtse rnam rgyal la'ang*/ /zad pa shes pa la dgu'o/ /mi g.yo bas ni bcu 'thob bo/ /der 'pho grol ba'i tha ma la'ang*/ /zhes byung*/ 'dod pa la chags bcas kyi 'phags pa chos can/ khyod kyis bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i tshe shes pa drug thob par byed de/

chos rjes gnyis dang bden bzhi shes pa dang drug thob pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i 'phags pa chos can/ khyod kyi de'i tshe bdun thob par byed de/ snga ma drug dang sems shes bcas bdun thob pa'i phyir/ de yi gong ma'i sgom lam pa chags bcas chos can/ khyod kyis ji ltar thob tshul yod de/ chags bral ma byas pa de srid du sgom pa'i lam la gnas pa'i tshe chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob/ shes pa gsum dang bden bzhi shes pa bzhi ste bdun thob par byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang pau gsum gyis bdun gyi nyon mongs las rgyal ba dag dang*/ mngon shes lnga dang*/ de thob byed kyi bar chad med pa'i lam dag dang gong ma srid rtse las grol ba'i rnam grol lam dang po brgyad la gnas pa'ang chos can/ shes pa bdun thob ste/ bshad ma thag pa bdun thob pa'i phyir/ rtog pa'i skal ba can mi g.yo ba'i chos can thob byed kyi bar chad med lam dang*/ bsam gtan spel sgom la bsgom la brtson pa'i bar chad med pa'i lam dag la gnas pa gnyis chos can/ khyod kyis kyang shes pa dgu bdun 'thob ste/ snga mas chos shes rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa zad shes dang bdun dang*/ phyi mas 'gog lam chos shes rjes shes bden bzhis shes pa kun rdzob shes pa dang bdun thob par byed pa'i phyir/ gong ma srid rtse'i sa la chags bral byas pa'i grol ba'i lam dang po brgyad chos can/ khyod la'ang shes pa bdun thob ste/ chos shes rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa sems shes thob pa'i phyir/ slob pa chags bcas dbang po sbyong ba'i grol ba'i lam la gnas pa chos can/ khyod kyis shes pa drug thob ste/ chos shes rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa dang drug thob pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i chags bral ba chos can khyod kyis bdun thob pa yod de/ snga ma drug gi steng du sems shes dang bdun thob pa'i phyir/ slob pa dbang po sbyong ba'i bar chad med pa'i lam la gnas pa'i 'phags pa dang de bzhin du srid rtse'i nyon mongs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'ang chos can/

shes pa drug re thob ste/ chos rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa rnams thob par byed pa'i phyir/ srid rtse'i rnam grol lam dgu pa zad pa shes pa la gnas pa chos can/ shes pa dgu thob ste/ mi skye ba shes pa ma gtogs dgu po thob pa'i phyir/ dbang rnon mi g.yo ba'i chos can dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos can mi g.yo ba der dbang po 'pho ba'i rnam grol lam tha ma dgu pa gnyis la gnas pa'ang chos can/ shes pa bcu thob pa yin te/ mi skye shes pa'ang thob pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bshad pa'i lhag ma la brgyad thob/ /zhes byung*/ sngar bshad pa'i lhag ma 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam grol lam dgu pa dang mngon shes dang spel sgos byed pa gsum chos can/ shes pa brgyad brgyad thob ste/ zad dang mi skye shes pa gnyis ma gtogs pa brgyad re thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sa gang du shes pa du thob pa ni/ gang la chags bral bya phyir gang*/ /thob pa der yang 'og ma 'thob/ /zad pa shes la zag bcas kyang*/ /sa kun sngon rnyed mi thob bo/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ lam gang gi skabs su shes pa du 'thob tshul yod de/ sa 'og ma gang la chags pa dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir sbyor lam sogs dang 'das lam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba dag gis sa 'og mas bsdus pa'i lam gang thob pa der yang rang sa dang 'og ma'i sas bsdus pa'i zag med kyi lam thob pa'i phyir/ zad pa shes pa la gnas pa chos can/ yon tan du ma thob ste/ zag med kyi yon tan du ma zad zag bcas kyi yon tan mi sdug pa sgoms dang dbugs rngub 'byung dang*/ dran nye dang*/ bsam gtan sa drug dang*/ gzugs med dang bcas pa bcu gcig po kun gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan thob pa'i phyir/ de yang sa kun las sngon ma rnyed pa thob pa yin gyi/ rnyed zin mi 'thob ste/ thob zin slar mi thob pa'i phyir/gsum pa thob pa'i dbye ba ni/ rnyed dang sten bcas bya ba ni/ /dge ba 'du byas 'thob pa'o/

/gnyen po dang ni thag bsring ba'i/ /thob pa zag dang bcas pa'i yin/ /zhes byung*/ thob pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ rnyed pa'i thob pa/ bsten pa'i thob pa/ gnyen po'i thob pa/ thag bsring ba'i thob pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de dag gi khyad par yod de/ sngar med gsar du rnyed pa de dang po dang*/ de skad cig gnyis pa phan chad du yang yang mngon du byed pa ni gnyis pa yin la/ de gnyis ka'ang dge ba 'dus byas kyi thob pa dang*/ spang bya spong bzhin pa'i skabs kyi thob pa de gsum pa dang*/ spang bya las grol ba'i skabs kyi thob pa de bzhin yin la/ de gnyis kyi thob pa ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos kyi thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma'i don 'chad tshul la mi 'dra ba yod de/ dge ba zag bcas la thob pa bzhi ga yod pa'i don du'ang bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag ni mtshon pa tsam yin te/ dge ba 'dus byas la rnyed bsten gyi thob pa gnyis/ zag bcas la gnyen po dang thag bsring ba gnyis/ zag med la rnyed bsten gnyis/ nyon mongs can dang lung ma bstan gyi thob pa la gnyen po dang thag bsring ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang*/ thun mong ba'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po la mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos ni ma 'dres pa/ /stobs la sogs pas so brgyad do/ /zhes byung*/ bye smra na re/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa chos can/ khyod la bco brgyad yod de/ stobs bcu la sogs pa ste mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum/ thugs rje chen po dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir zer/ lugs gzhan ltar na bco brgyad yod de/ rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug /spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug /'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste bco brgyad la 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ dran pa nyer gzhag dang*/

thugs rje chen po bzhi/ dang po la/ mkhyen pa'i stobs dang*/ sku'i stobs gnyis/ dang po ni/ so so'i ngo bo dang*/ sa gang du yod pa dang*/ sgra bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ gnas dang gnas min shes pa bcu/ /las 'bras la brgyad bsam gtan sogs/ /dbang po mos dang khams las ni/ /dgu'o lam dag lam bcu 'am/ /gnyis ni kun rdzob shes pa yin/ /zad pa drug gam bcu yin no/ /zhes byung*/ stobs dang po drug chos can/ shes pa bcus bsdus tshul yod de/ gnas dang gnas min pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni shes pa bcus bsdus/ las dang 'bras bu rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni 'gog lam gi shes pa gnyis min pa'i brgyad kyis bsdus/ bsam gtan dang sogs kyis gzugs med rnam thar sogs mkhyen pa dang dbang po mchog dman dang mos pa dag khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhi ni 'gog shes min pa'i shes pa dgus bsdus pa'i phyir/ stobs phyi ma bzhi chos can/ shes pa gang gis bsdus tshul yod de/ lam 'bras bu dag bcas na thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dag la shes pa bcu yod pas de rnams kyi bsdus pa'am/ /rang gi ngo bo'i dbang du byas na 'gog shes min pa'i dgus bsdus/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang 'chi 'pho dang skye ba'i mkhyen rab stobs gnyis ni kun rdzob shes pa yin la/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni 'gog pa kho na shes pa'i tshe chos shes rjes shes 'gog shes pa dang shes mi skye shes pa kun rdzob shes pa dang drug gis bsdus pa'am/ gzhan gyi tshe shes pa bcus bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon gnas 'chi 'pho skye ba'i stobs/ /bsam gtan dag na lhag ma ni/ /sa rnams kun na zhes byung*/ stobs bcu po chos can/ sa gang na yod pa'i khyad par yod de/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs ni bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi dag na yod/ stobs lhag ma brgyad ni 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar gyi sa rnams kun na yod pa'i phy-ir/gsum pa ni/

ci'i phyir/ 'di'i stobs gang phyir thogs mi mnga'/ /zhes byung*/ rgyu mtshan ci yi phyir na stobs zhes brjod ce na/ sangs rgyas 'di'i rgyun gyi stobs rnams chos can/ khyod la stobs shes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gi phyir na shes bya'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i mkhyen pa mthar thug yin pa de'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ sku la sred med bu yi stobs/ /gzhan dag tshigs na glang chen sogs/ /bdun cus glags pa'i stobs yin no/ /de ni reg bya'i skye mched do/ /zhes byung*/ sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi sku'i stobs bzhag tu yod de/ sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs mnga' ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gzhan dag na re/ tshigs sum brgya drug rtsa gnyis re re na'ang sred med kyi bu'i stobs mnga' zer/ sred med kyi bu'i stobs tshad yod de/ glang chen phal pa dang*/ sogs kyis spos kyi glang po che dang*/ tshan po che dang*/ rab gnon dang*/ yan lag mchog dang*/ stobs mchog dang*/ sred med kyi bu bdun po de snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma bcu 'gyur gyis stobs glags pa ste lhag pa'am che ba'i phyir/ slob dpon rang lugs ni sku'i stobs las thugs kyi stobs che bar bzhed de/ mtha' yas shing tshad med par bzhed pa'i phyir/ sku'i stobs de ni chos can/ reg bya'i skye mched yin te/ sku bem por 'dod pa'i lugs la ni 'byung bzhi'i khyad par kho nar 'dod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa ni/ mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /ji ltar stobs ni dang po dang*/ /bcu pa gnyis pa bdun pa bzhin/ zhes byung*/ mi 'jigs pa chos can/ rnam pa bzhi yod de/ rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs dang spangs pa phun tshogs gnyis dang*/ gzhan don bar chad kyi chos su dam bcas pa dang nges par 'byung ba'i lam la dam bcas pa gnyis te bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ de yang ji ltar stobs dang po gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni shes pa bcu dang sa thams cad kyis bsdus pa ltar mi 'jigs pa dang po dang*/

stobs bcu pa zag pa zad mkhyen pa ni shes pa drug gam bcu dang sa bcu gcig gis bsdus pa ltar mi 'jigs pa gnyis pa dang*/ stobs gnyis pa las 'bras mkhyen pa ni shes pa brgyad dang sa thams cad kyis bsdus pa ltar mi 'jigs pa gsum pa dang*/ stobs bdun pa kun tu 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa ni shes pa bcu'am dgu dang sa thams cad na yod pa ltar mi 'jigs pa bzhi pa yang de bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag bdag nyid gsum/ zhes byung*/ 'dir bstan dran pa nyer gzhag chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ 'khor gus pas chos nyan pa la mi chags pa'i de/ mi gus pas nyan pa la mi khro ba'i de/ gus mi gus 'dren ma la de gnyis mi 'byung ba'i btang snyoms dran pa nyer bzhag gi bdag nyid dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa thugs rje chen po ni/ thugs rje chen po kun rdzob blo/ /tshogs dang rnam pa spyod yul dang*/ /mnyam pa'i phyir dang ches che'i phyir/ /tha dad bya ba rnam pa brgyad/ ces byung*/ thugs rje chen po chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo'i khyad par yod de/ kun rdzob shes pa'i blo'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'jig rten la nyin mtshan dus drug tu su ni dar su ni rgud su ni smin su ni ma smin su ni ye shes kyis grol bar bya snyam du dgongs pa'i khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'i thugs rje chen po yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ thugs rje chen po zhes bya ste/ rgyu'i khyad par tshogs chen pos 'grub pa dang*/ rnam pa'i khyad par sems can gyi sdug bsngal la rtog pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ spyod yul gyi khyad par sems can thams cad la dmigs pa dang*/ 'jug tshul gyi khyad par sems can rnams la nye ring med par mnyam par 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ ngo bo'i khyad par chos rna ba dang ches che ba'i kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i thugs rje chen po ni snying rje chen po tsam la mi byed de/

snying rje chen po dang thugs rje chen po la tha dad du bya ba rnam pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snying rje chen po ni zhe sdang med pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po ni gti mug med pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes rab yin la/ snying rje chen po ni 'dod pa'i sems can la dmigs/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod gyi rnam pa can/ bsam gtan bzhi la brten pa/ nyan thos la'ang yod pa/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral bas thob pa/ 'dod khams kyi sems can skyob par 'dod pa/ 'phrin las kyang de ltar du 'jug pa yin la/ thugs rje chen po ni khams gsum gyi sems can la dmigs/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can/ bsam gtan bzhi pa nyid la brten pa/ sangs rgyas kho na la yod pa/ srid rtse la chags bral gyi tshul gyis thob pa/ khams gsum gyi sems can skyob par 'dod pa/ 'phrin las kyang de ltar kun la 'jug pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pas/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang*/ /rigs nas sku bong tshod kyis min/ /zhes byung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad chos can/ mnyam pa gsum gyis mnyam pa yin te/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags par mnyam pa dang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par mnyam pa dang*/ 'phrin las 'gro ba'i don spyod pas mnyam pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mi mnyam pa'i khyad par yod de/ sku tshe ring thung dang*/ rigs bzang ngan dang*/ sku bong tshong che chung ni gdul bya'i dbang gis mi mnyam pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa thun mong gi yon tan bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos gzhan slob dang thun mong yin/ kha cig so so skye bo dang*/ /nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /so so yang dag rig lon sogs/ /zhes byung*/ thun mong ba'i yon tan chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa las gzhan pa'i chos nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes pa dang*/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ bsam gzugs brgyad dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ rnam thar brgyad dang*/ zil gnon zad par sogs ni sangs rgyas dang slob ma nyan thos gnyis thun mong pa'i yon tan yin la/ yon tan de dag las bsam gzugs dang mngon shes dang tshad med sogs kha cig so so skye bo dang thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ slob pa 'phags pa dang thun mong pa'i yon tan dang*/ so skye dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyon mongs med pa dang*/ smon gnas shes pa dang*/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi dang*/ de dag thob tshul dang*/ zhar byung bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' ngos bzung ba lnga/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs med pa kun rdzob shes/ /bsam gtan mtha' na mi g.yo'i chos/ /mis skyed nyon mongs 'dod gtogs pa/ /ma skyes gzhir bcas spyod yul can/ /zhes byung*/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ khyad par lnga dang ldan te/ ngo bo kun rdzob shes pa yin la/ sa bsam gtan gyi ya mtha' bzhi pa kho nar brten pa/ gang zag dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can kho na la yod pa/ rten gling gsum gyi mis skyed pa kho na dang*/ dmigs pa 'dod par gtogs pa'i nyon mongs ma skyes pa ste skye 'gyur gzhi rgyu dang bcas pa la dmigs nas rnam pa pha rol po'i nyon mongs skye 'gyur 'di dang 'di mi skye bar gyur cig snyam pa'i spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ smon gnas shes pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de yi dmigs pa thams cad do/ /zhes byung*/ smon gnas shes pa'ang chos can/ sngar ma de bzhin du chos lnga dang ldan te/ gzhan gsum ni snga ma ltar yin la/ de'i dmigs pa chos thams cad la smon nas shes pa 'jug pa dang*/ rnam pa ni sngon nas smon pa btang ste 'di bshad par bya'o snyam du rab mtha'i bzhi pa la zhugs pas ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/

de bzhin chos don nges tshig dang*/ /spobs pa so so yang dag rig /gsum ni go rim bzhin ming dang*/ don dang ngag la thogs med shes/ /bzhi pa rigs pa thags thogs med/ /mngon brjod lam la dbang nyid la/ /de yi dmigs pa ngag dang lam/ /shes pa dgu'o sa thams cad/ /yang dag don rig cu'am drug /de ni kun na gzhan kun rdzob/ /chos ni 'dod dang bsam gtan na/ /ngag gi 'dod dang dang po na/ /zhes byung*/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa chos can/ khyod la dbye na bzhi yod de/ chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig dag spobs pa so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir dang*/ de dag gi rgyud dang rten gnyis nyon mongs med pa la bshad pa de bzhin yin la/ dmigs pa dang sa dang ngo bo gsum mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ de bzhi'i ngo bo'i khyad par yod de dang po gsum ni go rim bzhin du chos kyi ming ngam tshig dang don dang ngag gi khyad par so sor yang dag par rig pa dang*/ bzhi pa sbobs pa so so yang dag rig pa ni myang 'das sogs dang 'bral ba'i rig pa thags thogs med par mngon par brjod pa shes shing*/ lam ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba nyid gsal bar byed pa la thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ phyi ma de yi dmigs pa yod de/ ngag gi khyad par dang lam la dmigs pa'i phyir/ de bzhi chos can/ shes pa bcu dang sa gang gis bsdus pa yod de/ phyi ma spobs pa ni 'gog shes ma gtogs dgu dang*/ 'dod pa nas srid rtsa'i bar gyi sa thams cad na yod/ yang dag pa'i don rig pa ni chos thams cad la dmigs na shes pa bcu dang*/ myang 'das yin na 'gog pa chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob shes pa zad shes mi skye shes pa drug gis bsdus shing*/ de ni sa kun na yod la/ spobs don gnyis las gzhan pa'i tshes dang nges tshig rig pa gnyis ni kun rdzob shes pas bsdus/ chos rig ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan bzhi ste ldan yod cing*/ dag ste nges tshig rig pa ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/

ma tshang bar ni de thob med/ /drug po de dag rab mtha' las/ /zhes byung*/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi chos can/ khyod gang rung gcig thob na bzhi ka thob pas khyab ste/ gang rung gcig ma tshang bar ni de thob pa med pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas dang yang dag rig pa bzhi ste drug po de dag chos can/ khyod gang gis thob pa yod de/ rab mtha'i bsam gtan gyi stobs las thob pa'i phyir/lnga pa zhar byung rab mtha' ni/ de ni rnam drug bsam gtan mtha'/ /de ni sa kun gyis mthun byas/ /'phel bas rab tu phyin pa yin/ /sangs rgyas las gzhan sbyor las skyes/ /zhes byung*/ rab mtha' de ni chos can/ rnam pa drug yod de/ der gyur pa'i nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon gnas mkhyen pa dang*/ nges tshig ma gtogs pa'i so so yang dag pa rig pa gsum dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' nyid dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' 'di ni bsam gtan bzhi pa nyid na yod kyang bzhi pa thams cad ni rab mtha' min te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi rab tu phyin pa zhig la ni der 'jog pa'i phyir te/ rab mtha' de ni sa dgu kun gyis mthun par byas shing 'phel bas rab tu phyin pa zhig la 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rab mtha' la snyoms par 'jug nus na ni/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar dang*/ de nas slar yang 'dod sems kyi bar thams cad la dga' dgur snyoms par 'jug nus pa'i phyir/ bshad ma thag pa'i yon tan de dag chos can/ sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i gang zag la ni sbyor ba'i stobs kyis skyes pa yin te/ 'bad cing bsgrubs nas skyes pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas ni de ltar min te/ sbyor ba med par lhun grub tu thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa so skye dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa la/ mngon shes kyi dbye ba/ ngo bo/ chos kyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rdzu 'phrul rna ba yid dang ni/

sngon tshe 'chi 'pho skye ba dang*/ /zad shes mngon du bya ba yi/ /mngon shes rnam drug ces byung*/ mngon shes chos can/ khyod la rnam pa drug yod de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*/ lha'i rna ba'i dang*/ gzhan gyi yid de sems shes pa'i dang*/ sngon gyi tshe rabs sam gnas rjes su dran pa'i dang*/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba rjes su dran pa dang*/ zag pa zad pa shes pa mngon du bya ba yi mngon shes dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ de dag gi khyad par yod de/ rim pa bzhin du sprul pa gcig dang du mar sprul shes pa dang*/ sgra phra rags du ma thos pa dang*/ pha rol gyi sems kyi khyad par ci rigs shes pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi skye ba sngon ma du ma dran pa dang 'chi 'pho ba dang gang du skye ba shes pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i zag pa zad pa la der shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab dang bcas pa zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam grol blo/ /bzhi ni kun rdzob shes pa ste/ /sems la shes pa lnga yin no/ /zad pa'i mngon shes stobs bzhin no/ /zhes byung*/ de drug chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rnam par grol ba yan chad kyis bsdus pa'i blo'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon shes gsum pa dang drug pa ma gtogs pa'i gzhan bzhi ni kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ni chos shes rjes shes lam shes kun rdzob shes pa sems shes dang lngas bsdus pa yin la/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni stobs bzhin du drug gam bcus bsdus pa yid pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ khyad par gyi chos spyir bstan pa dang*/ mngon shes lnga so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sa'i khyad par/ dran pa nyer gzhag gi khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ rig pa'i khyad par/ cho 'phrul gsum gyi khyad par dang lnga/ dang po ni/ lnga ni bsam gtan bzhi dag na/ /rang dang 'og ma'i yul can yin/ /thob bya 'dris pas chags bral bas/ /zhes byung*/ mngon shes dang po lnga po chos can/

sa gang du yod pa'i khyad par yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi dag na yod cing gzugs med na yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ de lnga chos can/ rang sa dang 'og sa'i spyod yul can yin te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi des rang sa dang 'og sa'i de sprul nus kyi gong sas bsdus pa mi nus la/ rna ba'i des kyang rang sa dang 'og sa'i sgra thos kyi gong ma min/ de bzhin du gzhan gsum gyis kyang rang sa dang 'og sa'i min par gong sas bsdus pa ming shes pa'i phyir/ der thal/ shin tu mtho ba ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams kyis rang stobs las gong ma mngon sum du shes mi nus pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod thob tshul la gnyis yod de/ sngon tshor bas gzhan du ma 'dris par sbyor bas thob par bya ba yin la/ 'dris pas ni chags pa dang bral ba las thob par 'gyur pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gsum pa dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ dang po rna ba rdzu 'phrul mig /zhes byung*/ mngon shes drug chos can/ dran pa nyer bzhag gang dang ldan tshul yod de/ gsum pa gzhan sems shes ni sems tshor chos dran nye gsum gyis bsdus/ rna ba rdzu 'phrul mig gi mngon shes gsum ni dran nye dang po lus dran nyes bsdus/ mngon shes gzhan dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni/ /lung ma bstan dang lhag rnams dge /zhes byung*/ lugs 'dir mngon shes drug po chos can/ khyod la dge sogs gsum gang rung yin min gyi khyad par yod de/ mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni lung ma bstan yin la/ lhag ma rnams dge ba yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/ gsum ni rig pa sngon mtha' sogs/ ma rig pa ni bzlog phyir ro/ /mi slob tha ma gnyis ni de'i/ /rgyud la skyes phyir de zhes bya/ /slob la 'dod de ma rig dang*/ bcas rgyud phyir na rig ma bshad/ /ces byung*/ mi slob pa'i rig pa chos can/ khyod la gsum ni yod de/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi sngon gnas shes pa dang*/

'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes pa dang*/ zag pa zad pa shes pa gsum la rig pa gsum zhes bshad pa de yin pa'i phyir/ rig pa la de gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sngon mtha' dang sogs pas phyi ma'i mtha' dang bar la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ni bzlog par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mngon shes gsum po rim pa ltar gyis de gsum rnam par zlog par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi tha ma zag zad shes pa'i mngon shes nyid mi slob pa yin gyi/ gzhan gnyis ni slob mi slob gang rung yin yang de gnyis la'ang mi slob pa zhes bya bar brjod pa mi 'gal te/ de gnyis gang zag de'i rgyud la skyes pa'i phyir na de skad du brjod pa'i phyir/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang 'chi 'pho shes pa'i mngon shes gnyis ni slob pa la'ang yod par 'dod mod/ 'on kyang de gnyis skabs 'dir rig pa gsum gyi grangs su ma bshad de/ slob pa ni ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dir rig pa ni ma rig pa las grol ba'i ldog cha nas bshad dgos pa'i phyir/lnga pa ni/ dang po gsum pa drug pa ni/ cho 'phrul rnams yin bstan pa mchog /mi 'khrul phyir dang phan pa dang*/ /yid 'ong 'bras la sbyor byed phyir/ /zhes byung*/ cho 'phrul de chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mngon shes drug gi dang po ni rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang*/ mngon shes gsum pa gzhan sems shes pa ni kun rdzob pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ drug pa zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes kyi rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul yin pa'i phyir/ cho 'phrul ni yid 'phrog par byed pa'i 'phrul bstan pa las yin la/ cho 'phrul gsum gyi nang nas rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul mchog yin te/ des gdul bya yang dag pa'i don la 'jug par nges pas mi 'khrul/ gzhan gnyis ni de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir/

dang po der thal/ rjes bstan gyis phan pa dang yid du 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la nye bar sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mngon shes so sor bshad pa la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i mig rna bshad pa/ skyes thob yin min gyi khyad par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo bo 'bras bu bcas pa/ sems yul dang bcas pa/ sprul pa byed tshul zhar byung dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin de las ni/ /sprul dang 'gro ba ston pa la/ /yid mgyogs 'gro ba gzhan dag la/ /phyin byed mos pa las byung yang*/ /zhes byung*/ bye smra na re/ rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo bo yod de/ ting nge 'dzin zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ 'byor bar byed pas sam sgrub par byed pas de skad ces bya ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin des bsgrub par bya ba gnyis yod de/ de las byung ba'i sprul pa dang 'gro ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba'i tshul de la gsum yod de/ ston pa la yul thag shin tu ring yang thugs bskyed pa tsam gyis sleb pa'i yid ltar mgyogs pa'i 'gro ba yod la/ gzhan nyan rang dag la lus thag ring ba la bya bzhin du lus rim gyi phyin par byed pa dang*/ ring ba la nye bar mos pa las byung ba'i myur du phyin par byed pa yang yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sprul pa ni/ /phyi yi skye mched bzhi rnam gnyis/ /gzugs gtogs gnyis sprul sems dag gi /de dag kyang ni bcu bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan 'bras gnyis gnas lnga'i bar/ /rim bzhin gong ma las skyes min/ de rnyed bsam gtan bzhi de ni/ dag dang rang las de las gnyis/ /zhes byung*/ sprul pa chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ 'dod par gtogs pa dang gzugs su gtogs pa'i de gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sprul pa de ni chos can/ phyi'i skye mched yin te/ gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/

phyi'i sgra la sprul pa med de/ de la rigs 'dra'i rgyun med pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i sprul pa de chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ rang gi lus seng ge sogs su sprul pa dang*/ gzhan gyi lus de dag tu sprul pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir sprul pa po gang zag yin kyang gang zag dang dbang po sprul pa min par bshad de/ phyi'i skye mched bzhi sprul pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gzugs kyi rten can gyis skye mched gnyis sprul pa yin te/ gzugs su gtogs pa'i dri ro med pas gzugs dang reg bya'i skye mched gnyis sprul pa byed pa'i phyir/ mngon shes ni sprul pa byed pa min te/ de'i 'bras bu sprul sems dag gis sprul par byed pa'i phyir/ sprul sems de dag kyang chos can/ bcu bzhi yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'bras bu'i sprul sems la 'dod pa dang rang sa'i gcig ste gnyis dang*/ gnyis pa la rang sa man gsum dang*/ gsum pa la rang sa man bzhi dang*/ bzhi pa la sprul sems 'og sa bzhi dang rang sa gcig ste lnga'i bar rim pa bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ sa 'og ma'i sprul sems chos can/ sa gong ma las skyes pa min te/ rang sa dang 'og sa kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ sprul sems de chos can/ rnyed tshul yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhin du 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bas rnyed pa'i phyir/ sprul sems de ni chos can/ khyod kho na yas ldang bar 'gyur ba med de/ khyod ni dang po sprul pa la 'jug pa'i tshe bsam gtan dag pa dang*/ rgyun gyi tshe rang nyid dang gnyis las 'byung la/ sprul pa las ldang ba'i tshe yang bsam gtan dag pa ba dang rang nyid gnyis po de las ldang dgos pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ rang gi sa pas sprul par byed/ /smrar 'jug pa ni 'og mas kyang*/ /ston min sprul pa po dang bcas/ /byin gyis brlabs nas gzhan 'jug phyir/ shi ba la yang byin brlabs yod/ /mi brten la med gzhan dag min/

/dang po du mas gcig yin te/ /byang bar gyur nas bzlog pa'o/ / bsgoms las skyes pa lung ma bstan/ /skye ba las skyes rnam gsum mo/ /zhes byung*/ sa gzhan gyi sprul sems chos can/ de las sa gzhan gyi sprul pa mi byed de/ sprul pa ni rang sa'i sprul sems kyis sprul par byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyi sprul pa chos can/ khyod kyis smrar 'jug pa ni 'og ma bsam gtan dang po'i sems kyis byed de/ kyang ni der ma zad 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po na sprul pa smra ba rang sas byed par ston pa'i phyir/ sprul pa chos can/ smra ba'i tshul yod de/ ston pa ma yin pa'i sprul pa ni sprul pa po dang bcas te cig car smra de dgos la/ ston pa'i de sa ni ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin byed pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ sprul sems kyis dag smra bar byed dam min na gang gis smra bar byed ce na/ de ni smra sems kyis byed de/ dang po sprul pa gnas par byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas 'dis ngag 'di ltar smra bar gyur cig snyam du sprul sems las gzhan rtog dpyad dang bcas pa'i smra sems kyis smra ba la 'jug pa'i phyir/ byin gyis rlob pa po gson par ma zad/ shi ba la yang byin gyis brlabs pa yod de/ 'od srung chen po mya ngan las 'das pa'i rus pa byams pa 'jig rten du ma byon gyi bar du gnas par byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ de yang brtan pa rus pa la yin gyi sha la sogs pa ni min te/ de dag ni brtan pas mi rung ba'i phyir/ sde pa gzhan dag kha cig ni de ltar min te/ de'i rus pa gnas pa ni gnas gtsang gi lha'i mthu yin pa'i phyir zer/ 'o na/ sprul sems du mas sprul pa gcig byed dam gcig gis sprul pa du ma byed ce na/ gnyis ka la byed pa yod de/ dang po ni sprul sems du mas sprul pa gcig byed pa yin la/ phyis byang bar gyur nas de las bzlog pa sprul sems gcig gis kyang sprul pa du ma byed nus pa'i phyir/

sprul sems la lung ma bstan mang yang de kho nar ma nges te/ bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i sprul sems ni lung ma bstan du gnas gnyis par bshad zin pa ni 'di lta bu'i dbang du byas la/ lha klu la sogs pas skye ba'i stobs las skyes pa'i sprul sems la ni dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul gsang sngags sman dag dang*/ las las skyes dang rnam pa lnga/ /zhes byung*/ rdzu 'phrul chos can/ khyod la rnam pa lnga yod de/ bsgoms byung dang skyes thob dang*/ gsang sngags las skyes pa dang*/ sman 'ga' zhig rkang lag la bskus pa las skyes pa dag dang*/ las las skyes pa bar srid pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ lha yi mig dang rna ba ni/ /bsam gtan sa pa'i gzugs dang ba/ /rtag tu rten bcas ma tshang med/ /thag ring phra sogs spyod yul can/ /dgra bcom bse ru ston rnams kyis/ /stong gnyis gsum dang grangs med mthong*/ /zhes byung*/ lha'i mig dang rna ba chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus pa'i nang gi gzugs dang ba zhig yin pa'i phyir/ bsgoms byung gi lha'i mig rna gnyis chos can/ ngo bo'i khyad par yod de/ rtag tu rnam shes kyi rten bcas dang*/ long ba lta bu'i dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ thag ring ba'i gzugs sgra phra ba sogs mthong ba'i spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom dang ston pa rnams kyi lha'i mig gis ci tsam mthong ba'i tshad yod de/ nyan thos kyi lha'i mig gis stong gnyis dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi des stong gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi des stong gsum grangs med pa dag mthong ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ gzhan yang skye bas thob des ni/ /srid pa bar ma mi mthong ngo*/ /sems shes de ni rnam gsum gang*/ /rtog dang rig sngags kyis byas pa'ang*/
